verdict.rationale: Lago's own docs say it automatically generates invoices per customer according to the plan model, and that invoices can be downloaded or the invoice object used for a custom template. That covers only the invoice-generation core of the story. Missing for 10: credit notes, receipts, sequential numbering, custom fields, memos, automatic delivery to customers, compliance features, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, the platform generates compliant invoices, credit notes, and receipts — sequential numbering, custom fields, memos — delivered to customers automatically

citations.quote: Lago automatically generates invoices for each customer according to the plan model.
You can download invoices or use the invoice object to create your own invoice template.
